title: Tray Kabab
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.item: Kashmiri lal mirch (Kashmiri red chilies) soaked
items.raw: Kashmiri lal mirch (Kashmiri red chilies) soaked 3-4

items.item: Qeema (Mince) Beef or Mutton with fat
items.raw: Qeema (Mince) Beef or Mutton with fat 1/2 kg
Kali mirch powder (Black pepper powder) 1 tbs

steps.instruction: In chopper,add kashmiri red chilies,onion,garlic,green onion and fresh coriander,chop well & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Chopper mein kashmiri lal mirch,pyaz,lehsan,hara pyaz aur hara dhania dal ker ache tarhan chop ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: With the help of the cleaver,chop mince well.
steps.romanUrdu: Cleaver ki madad sa qeema ko ache tarhan chop ker lein.

steps.instruction: Now add chopped onion mixture,mix & chop well with the help of the cleaver.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab chopped pyaz mixture dal dein aur cleaver ki madad sa ache tarhan mix & chop ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add salt,red chili crushed,black pepper powder and tomato paste,mix and chop until well combined.
steps.romanUrdu: Namak,lal mirch crushed,kali mirch powder aur tomato paste dal dein aur ache tarhan mix aur chop ker lein.

steps.instruction: Put the mixture in a baking tray and spread evenly then cut into desired pieces.
steps.romanUrdu: Baking tray per mixture dal ker pheela lein aur desired pieces mein cut ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add tomato and green chili slices.
steps.romanUrdu: Tamatar aur hari mirch slices laga lein.

steps.instruction: Bake at 200 C for 45-50 minutes (turn on grill after 20 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: Preheated oven mein 200 per 45-50 minutes kliya bake ker lein (20 minutes ka bad grill on ker lein).

ogDescription: A unique and tasty Tray Kabab recipe with our little touch of fusion. Blasting with flavor and texture. Tray Kebabs are probably one of the most famous Kebabs in Turkey. #HappyCookingToYou
